changelog: Notes+ 19.0: due dates and repeats on list items, search across every note, links between notes, templates, import from Google Keep, Apple Notes and Markdown (and export to Markdown), home-screen widgets, separate idea and branch colours in mind maps, and pictures that open full screen. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ 19.0 for Windows: due dates and repeats, search across every note, Ctrl+K, links between notes, templates, import and export, and mind maps where you Ctrl+drag to select ideas and act on them together.
